mapper.sql: F.REF_FILE_SN AS refFileSn, F.TEAM_SN AS teamSn, F.REF_SE_CD AS refSeCd, F.ORGNL_FILE_NM AS orgnlFileNm, F.STRG_FILE_NM AS strgFileNm, F.FILE_PATH_NM AS filePathNm, F.FILE_SZ AS fileSz, F.FILE_EXTN_NM AS fileExtnNm, F.MEMO_CN AS memoCn, F.RGTR_ID AS rgtrId, U.USER_NM AS rgtrNm, F.REG_DT AS regDt
mapper.select: SELECT TEAM_SN FROM TB_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT FROM TB_REF_FILE F LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON U.USER_ID = F.RGTR_ID WHERE F.TEAM_SN = #{teamSn} AND F.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY F.REF_FILE_SN DESC
SELECT FROM TB_REF_FILE F LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON U.USER_ID = F.RGTR_ID WHERE F.REF_FILE_SN = #{refFileSn} AND F.DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_REF_FILE (TEAM_SN, REF_SE_CD, ORGNL_FILE_NM, STRG_FILE_NM, FILE_PATH_NM, FILE_SZ, FILE_EXTN_NM, MEMO_CN, RGTR_ID) VALUES (#{teamSn}, #{refSeCd}, #{orgnlFileNm}, #{strgFileNm}, #{filePathNm}, #{fileSz}, #{fileExtnNm}, #{memoCn}, #{rgtrId})
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_REF_FILE SET DEL_YN = 'Y', DLTR_ID = #{userId}, DEL_DT = SYSDATE WHERE REF_FILE_SN = #{refFileSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
